name: Garel Shuttle 63725
description: Garel Shuttle 63725 was a GX1 short hauler on Garel. In 4 BBY, the Spectres Sabine Wren and Chopper hijacked the shuttle after picking up the GNK-series power droid EG-86. The shuttle was damaged in a skirmish with the bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo's ship Shadow Caster. Sabine and Ketsu later blew up the shuttle in order to escape an Arquitens-class command cruiser.

data.name: Garel Shuttle 63725
data.armament: Turret-mounted double laser cannons (diplomatic version only)
